qa_pairs.question: From 2016 to 2022, is the trend pattern of the growth rate of the number of Chinese college entrance examination applicants consistent with that of the scale of higher education institutions? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The growth rate of the number of college entrance examination applicants shows a fluctuating upward trend (0.0% → 3.7% → 5.7% → 3.9% → 0.7% → 10.7%) with a relatively large fluctuation range. In the same period, the growth rate of the scale of higher education institutions is generally low and fluctuates gently (1.2% → 0.0% → 1.4% → 1.7% → 0.2% → 0.0%). The trend patterns of the two are not consistent.

qa_pairs.question: From 2016 to 2022, is there a corresponding relationship between the extreme - value years of the growth rate of the number of Chinese college entrance examination applicants and those of the scale of higher education institutions? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The extreme value of the growth rate of the number of college entrance examination applicants occurred in 2022 (10.7%, the highest); the extreme value of the growth rate of the scale of higher education institutions occurred in 2020 (1.7%, the highest). The extreme - value years of the two are different and there is no corresponding relationship.
